subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked jitter migration is resolved, should this umbrella continue tracking SecretRef and CDP/multi-root hardening, or should those leftovers be split into narrower issues?
rationale: The central crash-loop branch has an open implementation candidate, while the remaining branches cross SecretRef diagnostics, service supervision, and multi-user browser profile isolation, which is broader than one safe automated repair.

options.title: Resolve jitter first, then split leftovers
options.body: Keep this issue open until the linked jitter PR lands or closes, then split any still-reproducible SecretRef or CDP/service-isolation work into focused follow-ups.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for all three branches, accepting that automation should remain paused until a maintainer scopes the remaining work.

options.title: Declare non-jitter branches out of scope
options.body: After the jitter fix lands, close this issue if current SecretRef and service hardening are considered sufficient for the original report.
